quotes.text: 1a. ¿En la semana pasada, trabajó por lo menos una hora? (sin contar las tareas de su hogar)
... no podía trabajar por razones personales? (cuidado del hogar, estudios, incapacidad)

assessments.reasoning: The survey explicitly excludes unpaid household tasks from the definition of work. Question 1a asks if the respondent worked at least one hour in the past week with the explicit instruction '(sin contar las tareas de su hogar)'. In addition, question 1e classifies '(cuidado del hogar, estudios, incapacidad)' as personal reasons for not being able to work, treating household care as a reason for non-work rather than work itself.
